note: _et hoc_ [spiritus], _quod continet omnia, scientiam habet vocis_ – and that which containeth all things hath knowledge of the voice (Douay Version). Since _hoc_ (neuter) refers back to the divine spirit, one would expect the masculine forms _hic, qui_. – Alois Hudal et al.: _Einleitung in das Alte Testament_. Sechste Auflage, neubearbeitet von Franz Sauer. Graz 1948 (xii, 271 pp.), pp. 79–80.
